audioText: W: Hello! I'm Li Hua. What's your name? M: Hi, Li Hua. I'm Tom. Nice to meet you!
q: What is the boy's name?

audioText: W: Anna, where are you from? M: I'm from Germany. I can speak German and English.
q: Where is Anna from?

audioText: M: My hobby is playing the guitar. What about you? W: I love reading books.
q: What is the girl's hobby?

audioText: W: My elder brother is an engineer. He is very clever. M: Sounds great!
q: What is the woman's brother's job?

audioText: W: What time do you get up, Tom? M: I always get up at six thirty.
q: What time does Tom get up?

audioText: W: How do you go to school, Amy? M: I go to school on foot.
q: How does Amy go to school?

audioText: W: When does school end? M: It ends at four thirty in the afternoon.
q: When does school end?

audioText: W: Do you often play table tennis after school? M: Yes, every day with my friends.
q: How often does the boy play table tennis?

audioText: M: The Earth is our home. We must protect it. We can recycle paper and plastic.
q: What does the speaker say about the Earth?

audioText: W: Don't throw waste on the ground, please. M: Sorry, I will put it in the bin.
q: What will the boy do?
options: put the waste in the bin

audioText: M: There are many forests and oceans on the Earth. Animals live in them.
q: Where do animals live?

audioText: W: We should turn off the tap when we brush our teeth. It saves water.
q: What does the woman suggest?
explain: turn off the tap → save water

audioText: W: Look outside! It's raining. M: Let's stay at home and read books.
q: What is the weather like?

audioText: M: I love summer. We can swim in the sea. W: Me too!
q: What does the boy love about summer?
explain: We can swim in the sea.

audioText: W: In autumn, leaves turn yellow and fall. I love this season.
q: When do leaves turn yellow?

audioText: M: It's snowing! Let's put on our scarves and gloves.
q: What will they wear?

audioText: W: One day, we will travel to the Moon by rocket. I can't wait!
q: How will they travel to the Moon?

audioText: M: There is no air on the Moon. We must wear spacesuits to breathe.
q: Why do astronauts wear spacesuits on the Moon?
explain: No air → must wear spacesuits to breathe.

audioText: W: I want to be an astronaut. I love science and space. M: That's a great dream.
q: What does the girl want to be?
explain: I want to be an astronaut.

audioText: M: The Moon is about 384,000 kilometres from the Earth.
q: How far is the Moon from the Earth?

audioText: W: Beijing is the capital of China. The Great Wall is there. M: I want to visit it!
q: What is the capital of China?
explain: Beijing is the capital of China.

audioText: M: Tokyo is a very modern city in Japan. Tokyo Tower is famous.
q: Where is Tokyo?

audioText: W: Bangkok has many old palaces and delicious Thai food.
q: What does Bangkok have?

audioText: M: Xi'an is an ancient capital of China. It has the Terracotta Army.
q: What famous site is in Xi'an?

audioText: W: Every Friday afternoon we can join different clubs. I will join the Music Club.
q: Which club will the girl join?
explain: I will join the Music Club.

audioText: M: I can draw very well. I want to join the Art Club.
q: Which club does the boy want to join?

audioText: W: Chess makes you think fast. We have a school chess game every year.
q: How often is the school chess game held?

audioText: M: Our Science Club is building a robot called Star. It can say 'Hello'.
q: What can the robot do?

audioText: W: My hobby is collecting stamps. I have more than 300 stamps.
q: How many stamps does the girl have?

audioText: M: The 1980 red monkey stamp is very valuable. It is my favourite.
q: Which stamp is the boy's favourite?

audioText: W: Grandpa told me: never touch stamps with dirty hands.
q: What did grandpa say?
explain: never touch with dirty hands → 保持手干净

audioText: M: I like sharing my collection with my friends. It makes me happy.
q: Why does the boy share his collection?
